flowchart.title: Flowchart
flowchart.alt: Flowchart: Write Markdown, then a decision 'Looks right?'. Yes leads to Export or share, No loops back to Write Markdown.
flowchart.source:
flowchart LR
  A[Write Markdown] --> B{Looks right?}
  B -- Yes --> C[Export or share]
  B -- No --> A

sequence.title: Sequence diagram
sequence.alt: Sequence diagram: You type Markdown in the editor, get a live preview, choose Copy for Docs, and the formatted text is pasted into Google Docs.
sequence.source:
sequenceDiagram
  participant You
  participant Editor
  participant Docs as Google Docs
  You->>Editor: Type Markdown
  Editor-->>You: Live preview
  You->>Editor: Copy for Docs
  Editor->>Docs: Paste with formatting

gantt.title: Gantt chart
gantt.alt: Gantt chart of a writing plan: an outline and first draft under Draft, then review and publish under Publish.
gantt.source:
gantt
  title Writing plan
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
  section Draft
  Outline      :done,   a1, 2026-01-05, 3d
  First draft  :active, a2, after a1, 5d
  section Publish
  Review       :        a3, after a2, 3d
  Publish      :        a4, after a3, 1d

pie.title: Pie chart
pie.alt: Pie chart of where writing time goes: drafting 45, editing 35, formatting 10 and publishing 10.
pie.source:
pie title Where writing time goes
  "Drafting" : 45
  "Editing" : 35
  "Formatting" : 10
  "Publishing" : 10

class.title: Class diagram
class.alt: Class diagram: a Template class with name and open(), extended by Readme and MeetingNotes.
class.source:
classDiagram
  class Template {
    +String name
    +open()
  }
  class Readme
  class MeetingNotes
  Template <|-- Readme
  Template <|-- MeetingNotes

state.title: State diagram
state.alt: State diagram: Draft goes to Review on submit; Review returns to Draft when changes are requested or moves to Published on approval.
state.source:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Draft
  Draft --> Review : submit
  Review --> Draft : changes requested
  Review --> Published : approve
  Published --> [*]

er.title: Entity-relationship diagram
er.alt: Entity-relationship diagram: an author writes many posts, and each post is tagged with one or more tags.
er.source:
erDiagram
  AUTHOR ||--o{ POST : writes
  POST ||--|{ TAG : "is tagged with"

mindmap.title: Mind map
mindmap.alt: Mind map with Markdown at the centre and three branches: Write (headings, lists), Format (bold, links) and Export (PDF, Word).
mindmap.source:
mindmap
  root((Markdown))
    Write
      Headings
      Lists
    Format
      Bold
      Links
    Export
      PDF
      Word
